about: The Dhan 5-year download (bullet, dated; ADR-0014). Order: Nifty, Bank Nifty, then 'first' (the 30 most liquid stocks, as the legacy Lab), then every other F&O stock by turnover. Strikes: indices ATM±index_offsets, the first wide_count stocks ATM±wide_offsets, the rest ATM±narrow_offsets. It runs only after the switch-over and only in 'run_when' (never in market hours). daily_cap stays under Dhan's 100,000 calls a day; rate under Dhan's 5 a second. Copied from the legacy download (lab/dhan_hist.py, 2.21) on 14 Nov 2026.
